Section I: Recent PE Market Developments
Improved financing and greater pricing clarity are supporting transactions, while capital continues to concentrate around high-conviction assets
• Greater rate visibility is improving deal certainty and execution • Large portions of LBO financing in 2024-25 came from private credit
• Buyer and seller expectations are moving closer • The gap between held and exited asset multiples narrowed to ~0.3x
• Sponsors remain selective, concentrating capital in resilient assets • Median buyout entry multiples reached a record 11.8x EV/EBITDA in 2025
